tag.description: Image tag; empty uses the chart appVersion.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy; null uses global.image.pullPolicy.

pvcStorageClass.description: PVC StorageClass; empty uses the cluster default.

existingConfigMap.description: ConfigMap of public bundle-signing keys; empty creates one from keys.

keys.description: Public keys by key ID for a chart-created ConfigMap.

kind.description: Signed document kind the gateway requests.

tlsSecret.description: Sandbox admission (OpenShell gateway interceptor) Secret with tls.crt, tls.key, and trust.toml.

extraArgs.description: Arguments appended after the chart-managed flags.

extraEnv.description: Environment variable entries appended to the container.

enabled.description: Creates a PVC for antirollback counters.

mountPath.description: Audit directory mounted in both containers.

create.description: Creates a ServiceAccount for the pod.

name.description: ServiceAccount name; empty derives it from the release.

enabled.description: Creates a NetworkPolicy for the listeners.

admissionFrom.description: NetworkPolicyPeer entries allowed to reach the sandbox admission port.

egressFrom.description: NetworkPolicyPeer entries allowed to reach the egress request policy port.

revision.description: Change to restart the pod after an external Secret or ConfigMap changes.

openshift.description: Omits explicit UID and GID so OpenShift assigns them.

runAsUser.description: Pod user ID; applied unless openshift is true.

runAsGroup.description: Pod group ID; applied unless openshift is true.

fsGroup.description: Pod filesystem group; applied unless openshift is true.

nodeSelector.description: Node labels the pod must match.

extraContainers.description: Sidecar containers appended to the pod.
